notes.title: Major updates : Elite monsters
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650971/d4a5646dc446ed3eff25dd1dab1566b989bd23ed.png[/img]


[h1]Content updates[/h1]


[h2]4 Elite monsters are added[/h2]


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650971/5071b62e42cc92e448d30d1009c2dd8dfbea44df.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650971/23191bd9fd8c673d8fa8b68cd16f387621f36e6b.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Baron[/h3]

Deep iced cave in dream, through a giant machine shaped like spider, you feel some weired elegant from it.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650971/2f36ecf1387628004dbba8f866c0298147d0fc38.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650971/4e79ab2a242084fba4ec55c4cba1918be0d1706e.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Eel[/h3]

In the bizarre moving do not go with it's gigantic size, you feel sight someone looking through.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650971/8121b46338ad2df6abc521e1ae3c7e93c52c4489.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650971/91e6a49ad24080ace65897c48271107adb7f635f.png[/img][/url]

[h3]DIsenchanter[/h3]

Making a stand with that absolute violance advocating purism, you realized your only way is spoiling yourself.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650971/4719425063c04f5cd709d8d096ab9e9121504c86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38650971/4b4b38e08fe5073a5c0052c488dcf07ebaebd036.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Enchanter[/h3]

Watching the deep sense of loss digs in between the poruing blessings, you asked yourself whether you can endure it.

---------------------------------

[h1]Changes[/h1]

Way to calculating damages with items is changed.
Changed to can not gain tokesn when you have not enough space.
Player / Energy Charge Slots / Sanctum UI position is readjusted.
Tooltip for sanctum is added.
Add pop up warning before overwriting the save data.
When battle information's numbers are grown up to over 100, those numbers will changed to '...'.
Relics related with revealing tile's information now changed to reveal that information right away.
After 4th floor, equipments' price will be changed.
Button for skipping loot cards is changed to understand intuitively.

--------------------------------

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[h2]Equipment bug fixes[/h2]

Fixed relics related with nightmare doesn't works properly bug. 
Relic : Sheath - Damage calculating bug is fixed.
Relic : Pocket of dimention - Gimic doesn't work bug is fixed.
Relic : Scrap metal - Number you have doesn't displayed normally bug is fixed.
Relic : Shock Cyliner - Effect activates always bug is fixed.
Relic : Burglar's Gloves - Bug occuring when you activates its effect is fixed.
Equipment : Ice pick -  Residual effect doesn't works bug is fixed.
Equipment : Clup / War hammer - bug occuring when you equip those equipments during battle is fixed.

[h2]Monster bug fixes[/h2]

Monster : Blood Stalker - bugs related with this monster is fixed.
Monster : Mold epidemic - bugs related with weakness pattern is fixed.
Boss Monster : Crusher - Targetting position is abnoraml bug is fixed.
Boss Monster : The way from Hades - When you starting battle, the nightmare gauge effects abnormally bug is fixed.

[h3]Other fixes[/h3]

Bugs from monster died by status effects are fixed.
When you get equiments you get double of it bug is fixed.
Bugs related with equipment selling are fixed.
Equipment selling window doesn't close bug is fixed.
Bugs related with Abandoned Mine / Dream Essence / Destruction Brigade event are fixed.
Cards you get after use all of your card in deck doesn't disappear bug is fixed.
Bugs related with shock slots are fixed.

notes.title: V0.9.4 bug fix
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where if the equipment slot was left empty and the action was taken in battle, it would cause serious problems for subsequent play.
- Fixed an issue where tile creation did not proceed properly after the 4th floor.
- We have reset the settings that were previously made to fix bugs.

In addition to this, we will try to deal with any reported or discovered bugs as quickly as possible.

notes.title: V0.9.3 bug fix
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where equipment effects that attack multiple targets at the same time did not work properly.
- Fixed an issue where starting a battle with at least one equipment slot empty would cause serious problems with the subsequent play.

In addition to this, we will try to deal with any reported or discovered bugs as quickly as possible.

notes.title: V0.9.3 3rd game improvement
notes.content:
Improved game performance so that it can run better on low-end computers.
Minor fixes to get more detailed bug report information. This modification will be restored to its original state under the judgment that the official release or build is stable.

notes.title: Hot fix for V0.9.2 Update
notes.content:
We have implemented an emergency bug patch.
During the playtest, we found a phenomenon in which the movement value of the movement card was unconditionally fixed to 1 due to the part that was fixed to catch a trap-related bug, and it was determined that it was causing a serious problem in gameplay, and we urgently fixed it.

notes.title: V0.9.2 2nd bug fix and game improvement
notes.content:
- Fixed a part where the option of the Destruction Brigade event and the actual motion did not match

- Fixed the part of the map screen returning to the lobby when closing the routing window opened like a 
treasure chest without a battle.

- Fixed an issue where right-clicking on a specific button did not work but did produce a click sound

- Restored right-click close functionality. In addition, several UI shortcuts have been designated. In the next patch, these shortcuts will appear in tooltips.

- Fixed an issue where undiscovered trap tiles could block the path, making it easier to infer the presence or absence of a trap. However, the ability to stop movement when triggering a trap is the same.

- Modified to increase the health value as well as the maximum health increase function of the banquet card.

- Corrected the effect value of Poison Moisture's Poison Status. Poison Moisture is now adjusted to 4 -> 2 poisons placed on players when killed and 3 -> 2 poisons placed on special skills.

- Fixed an issue where Grow didn't die on that turn even if he applied additional damage to the turn when he entered the growth state and made his health to 0.

- Fixed a situation where the effect triggered when equipped with equipment was active even at the start of the battle. Now, this effect will only take effect when equipment is replaced during combat.

- Fixed the part where the preheat and cooldown values ​​were displayed in the reversed state in the equipment tooltip.

- Fixed the function of artifacts where the effect of increasing the maximum health when acquired did not work properly.

- Fixed gold gain and loss of Ring-patterned Note from 15/5 to 3/1.

In addition to this, we will try to deal with any reported or discovered bugs as quickly as possible.

notes.title: Hot fix for V0.9.1 Update
notes.content:
We have implemented an emergency bug patch.
We have urgently fixed an issue that caused serious disruption to gameplay due to a serious error in the process of adding treasure chests, conditional adding looting data, and random adding looting data generated by artifacts.

notes.title: V0.9.1 1st bug fix and game improvement
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the volume could not be adjusted in the lobby.

- Removed Lucid Pedia's pop-up function that was interrupted when playing the first game It will be reorganized or retained in another form later.

- Fixed a situation where resizing was possible in window mode to prevent resizing.

- Temporarily removed the shortcut to close the window by clicking the right mouse button. Instead, a close button has been added to all UIs that were previously possible to close and cancel by right-clicking.

- Improved the part that reacted too quickly when losing or winning a battle.

- Corrected the BGM volume of the battle screen.

- Flug's relic 'Sheath's function activation timing (activated when equipped) has been corrected.

- Corrected the defeat conditions on the map screen. Game over is now detected during card draw.

- Fixed an error that occurred in battle-related options during the event.

- Modified UIs that do not have tooltips or are not translated.
	- Exit the game, save and exit
	- Card looting
	- Shock, energy charge
	- Display remaining cards

In addition to this, we will try to deal with any reported or discovered bugs as quickly as possible.
